claims.claim: Canva Craft uses a two-stage process where the model first creates a design plan covering object placement, relative sizes, visual hierarchy, and text positioning before generating the image.
claims.episode_span: In the first step the model reads your words and creates an invisible blueprint that lists every object, its size, its position, and even where the text should sit. Only after that plan is finished does the second step turn the blueprint into actual pixels.
claims.source_title: Canva Launches Its Own AI Image Generator to Take on Google and OpenAI
claims.supporting_quote: Canva Craft uses a two-stage process to generate images from text prompts. In the first stage, the model analyzes the user’s instructions and creates a design plan covering object placement, relative sizes, visual hierarchy, and text positioning. In the second stage, it generates the image based on that plan.

claims.claim: Canva Craft supports resolutions of up to 2K and 30 different aspect ratios.
claims.episode_span: The model supports resolutions up to 2K and more than 30 different aspect ratios, so the same prompt can produce a square Instagram post or a wide desktop wallpaper without extra work.
claims.supporting_quote: supporting resolutions of up to 2K and 30 different aspect ratios.
